notes.title: Alvorsted (S20) Patch Notes
notes.content:
Alvorsted (S20) will start today, 05.05.2022, at 11:00 CEST. We are happy to announce a big upgrade to the Training Grounds coming with it to all servers!

See below the main changes:
🔹Realm Tournament replaces the Training Grounds
🔹Iteration on the reworked map generation
🔹Plans for further changes to the endgame

For more details about the upcoming changes visit [url=https://forum.arkheim.com/forum/index.php?thread/1454-alvorsted-s20-starts-on-5th-of-may/]our forum [/url]!

We are happy to hear your impressions and feedback about the upcoming changes also in [url=https://bit.ly/Arkheim_Discord]our Discord[/url] especially in  #realm-tournament and #map-generation.

The update is also live on Carby (S19), which will effectively replace the old Training Grounds there.

We might experience a small update maintenance with the Tournament, making it briefly unavailable, but we will keep you up to date.

See you all on the battlefield!

notes.title: Update 11.04
notes.content:
Join a new round of Arkheim on our server Carby bringing big improvements to the game!

[list]
[*] Reworked map generation & realm spawning
[*] Being able to transform portals to Realm Arks
[*] Improvements for usability in the map view (several aspects of the map view have been improved)
[*] Several balancing changes
[/list]
